auditor: security-auditor (independent, Audit Wave — no separate reviewers)
methodology: OWASP Top 10 (2021), full-file review of the final state of all source files created/modified in tasks 1-7; five tech-spec-pinned focus areas (preview XSS, validation completeness, log hygiene, preview IDOR, wire-body injection) verified explicitly plus the remaining OWASP categories across the changed components.

confirmed_invariants.title: Preview XSS surface — backend renders keyboard text via VariableTemplateRenderer (escaped per parse mode), labels echoed verbatim but clamped; frontend renders via {{ }} only, zero v-html (Decision 7, focus area 1)
evidence: FunnelService.previewStep keyboard branch (FunnelService.java:428-441): keyboardText rendered through renderTextBlock -> VariableTemplateRenderer.render(text, keyboardParseMode, subscriber) as exactly one TEXT RenderedBlock — the same renderer/parse-mode escaping as the runtime engine, so substituted variable values are escaped (HTML: & < > "; MarkdownV2: full special set — VariableTemplateRenderer.java:168-211). Author markup is intentionally left untouched (Telegram parse-mode semantics), matching engine behavior — preview is byte-faithful.

Button labels are NEVER variable-rendered (they are the keyword link); clampKeyboardLabels (FunnelService.java:470-498) echoes them verbatim but TRUNCATES to the validation caps: <=10 rows, <=4 buttons/row, label substring(0,64). So the preview response can never reflect an unbounded/unvalidated payload even though it accepts live (possibly unvalidated) form state. null rows/buttons/text are skipped defensively (no NPE).

FunnelMessagePreview.vue keyboard branch (lines 234-261): keyboardText output via {{ keyboardText }} (line 239), each label via {{ label }} (line 258) — all {{ }} interpolation, never v-html. Line breaks via CSS whitespace-pre-wrap, not markup.

grep over frontend/components/funnels + types/funnel.ts + both locale files for v-html|innerHTML|outerHTML|dangerouslySet|insertAdjacentHTML|document.write returns ONLY affirming comments — zero actual HTML sinks. The no-v-html source guard holds for the new keyboard render path.
New locale keys (uk.json / en.json keyboard*, previewKeyboard*) are plain text with no raw HTML, so no component is forced to inject markup.

confirmed_invariants.title: Input validation completeness — caps 10x4, text <=4096, label <=64, trimmed-duplicate block, CLEAR_KEYBOARD strict field rejection, all -> 422 funnel_step_invalid, no NPE on null shapes (Decision 6, focus area 2)
evidence: validateSetKeyboard (FunnelService.java:1291-1326): requireKeyboardText (non-blank, <=MAX_KEYBOARD_TEXT 4096 HARD — line 1347-1354), requireParseMode (null|HTML|MarkdownV2 — line 1230-1234), rows null/empty -> 422, rows>10 -> 422, per-row null/empty-buttons -> 422, buttons>4 -> 422, per-button null/blank text -> 422, text>64 (MAX_KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TEXT = MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH 64) -> 422, duplicate on TRIMMED text via HashSet.add -> 422. Every throw is invalidStep -> AppException.unprocessableEntity(CODE_INVALID_STEP) (line 1356-1358).

validateClearKeyboard (FunnelService.java:1332-1344): mandatory text + parse mode, then STRICT rejection — keyboardRows != null -> 422, isPersistent != null -> 422, oneTimeKeyboard != null -> 422 (an empty-but-non-null list still counts as present). Symmetric, no silently-ignored fields.

Null-shape safety: toKeyboardRows (FunnelService.java:806-827) carries a null row through as null, a null buttons list as KeyboardRow(null), a null button element as null — all reach validateSetKeyboard which rejects them with a 422 (the null/null-buttons/null-button guards at lines 1306, 1314) rather than NPE. The DTO->domain mapper never dereferences a nullable nested field unsafely.

Frontend mirror (FunnelStepForm.vue:629-670): KEYBOARD_TEXT_MAX 4096 (raw length, matching backend text.length()), KEYBOARD_MAX_ROWS 10, KEYBOARD_MAX_BUTTONS_PER_ROW 4, KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TEXT_MAX 64; keyboardHasDuplicate uses Set over button.text.trim() — byte-for-byte parity with the backend trimmed-duplicate check (HashSet of button.text().trim()). Mirror is a UX backstop; the 422 is authoritative.

CLEAR_KEYBOARD onSubmit (FunnelStepForm.vue:976-989) emits ONLY stepType/keyboardText/keyboardParseMode/id/next — never keyboardRows/isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard, so a well-formed editor never trips the strict rejection; a hand-crafted body still 422s.

confirmed_invariants.title: Log hygiene — keyboard StepExecutor cases and their error mapping log ids/codes only; no rendered text, labels, or chat content (focus area 3)
confirmed_invariants.owasp: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
evidence: setKeyboard/clearKeyboard/sendKeyboardText (StepExecutor.java:343-379): the ONLY log site on the keyboard send path is the shared renderTrimmed (StepExecutor.java:274-283), whose WARN logs LOG_TEXT_TRIMMED (a static code), execution.getId(), execution.getCurrentStepIndex(), originalLength (int), trimmedTo (int) — ids + a code + lengths only, NEVER the rendered text or any label.
The defensive guard returns StepResult.fail("empty_keyboard_rows") (line 346) — a static code string, no logging of content, no labels.

Error mapping is byte-for-byte the shared trio: TelegramSendException -> fromTerminalReason (returns reason.name() — an enum constant), BotTokenInvalidException -> fail("invalid_bot_token") (constant), AppException -> fail(codeOrStatus(ex)) (ex.getCode() or HTTP status int — never ex.getMessage()). None of these branches log a payload.

Downstream sender error logging (TelegramSender.sendMapped catch, TelegramSender.java:339-340) runs scrubTokens(ex.getMessage()) — the existing scrub pipeline, and it never logs the request body/reply_markup/labels. This path is unchanged by the feature.
validate* messages name fields/limits in plain English but never echo author content (e.g. "SET_KEYBOARD has duplicate button texts" — no label value), consistent with the PII-free convention.

confirmed_invariants.title: Anti-IDOR on the preview path — requireOwned FIRST then projectId-scoped funnel lookup, then step lookup; fail-closed uniform 404 (Decision 7, focus area 4)
evidence: FunnelController.previewStep (FunnelController.java:122-129): projectId/funnelId/stepId from @PathVariable; ownerId from currentUserId() (SecurityContextHolder -> AppUserDetails, lines 131-137) — never from the body.

FunnelService.previewStep (FunnelService.java:406-410) calls requireFunnel(ownerId, projectId, funnelId) FIRST, then findStep on the resolved funnel. requireFunnel (lines 593-606) calls projectService.requireOwned(ownerId, projectId) before any DB read, then filters the loaded funnel by projectId.equals(f.getProjectId()) — a cross-project or missing funnelId collapses to the same notFound(MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND); a malformed ObjectId also collapses to 404 (no existence leak / enumeration).
findStep (FunnelService.java:554-559) searches ONLY funnel.getSteps() of the already-ownership-verified funnel — a foreign stepId yields Optional.empty -> 404. No lookup bypasses the ownership scope.

The keyboard branch gates on step.getStepType() — the SAVED step's type (FunnelService.java:428,437), NOT request.stepType() (which is documented dead code in PreviewStepRequest). A client cannot drive the keyboard render path by claiming a stepType in the body; only a genuinely-saved SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD step reaches it. No new lookup was introduced.

confirmed_invariants.title: No wire-body injection via button labels — reply_markup built as LinkedHashMap/List, buttons in object form {"text":...}, serialized verbatim by Jackson; no string concatenation, no sibling-key injection (Decision 5, focus area 5)
evidence: buildReplyKeyboardMarkup (StepExecutor.java:396-414): builds a LinkedHashMap with EXACTLY the keys keyboard / is_persistent / resize_keyboard / one_time_keyboard. Each button is a fresh LinkedHashMap with the single literal key "text" mapped to button.text() as a VALUE (line 402-403). The label is data, never a key, never concatenated into a string. There is no path where a label becomes a JSON key or a non-text button field — sibling keys (selective, web_app, request_contact, input_field_placeholder) are simply not emitted.
REMOVE_KEYBOARD_MARKUP (StepExecutor.java:387) is a constant Map.of("remove_keyboard", true) — no user input at all.

resize_keyboard is hardcoded literal true (line 411 — never read from the step); is_persistent / one_time_keyboard fall back to literal true/false on null (lines 410,412) so a JSON null is never emitted; they are Boolean values, not user-controlled keys.

TelegramSender.sendText 6-arg (TelegramSender.java:149-161) places the markup Object under contentFields.put("reply_markup", replyMarkup) ONLY when non-null, then the body is serialized by the HTTP client's Jackson mapper — the label enters the JSON as a Jackson-escaped string value. No string concatenation into the request body anywhere on this path.
Engine slow-lane IT (Decision 9, Task 6) asserts the exact /sendMessage body shape via MockWebServer JsonNode walk, pinning that only the documented keys appear.

confirmed_invariants.title: Mass-assignment — new DTO fields are content-only; no ownerId/projectId/botId/order readable from the body; @JsonIgnoreProperties drops unknown fields (patterns.md DTO whitelist)
evidence: FunnelStepDto (FunnelStepDto.java:27-61) appends only keyboardText/keyboardParseMode/keyboardRows/isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard — all content fields. No ownerId/projectId/botId. order is intentionally absent (server rewrites from array index — toSteps step.setOrder(i), FunnelService.java:753). Carries @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true).

PreviewStepRequest (PreviewStepRequest.java:28-35) carries stepType/blocks/keyboardText/keyboardParseMode/keyboardRows only, @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true). No identity fields; request.stepType() is dead (the service gates on the saved type), so even a spoofed stepType cannot redirect rendering.

KeyboardRowDto / KeyboardButtonDto (net-new) carry @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) and only buttons / text respectively — consistent with the other funnel DTOs; a hostile payload with extra fields is silently ignored, never a 400/500.

PreviewStepResponse (PreviewStepResponse.java:21-22) returns EXACTLY {renderedBlocks, sampleData, kind, keyboardRows} — no ownerChatId / subscriber identity leaks to the client (the stub subscriber is never serialized; only rendered text + raw labels go out).

confirmed_invariants.title: Variable-substitution injection in keyboardText — single-pass non-recursive renderer, substituted values escaped per parse mode
evidence: keyboardText flows through the SAME VariableTemplateRenderer.render as every other send/preview text. Substitution is single-pass and non-recursive (VariableTemplateRenderer.java render loop): a {user.*}/{custom.*} value containing braces is NOT re-parsed, so a value cannot inject a new placeholder; values are escaped per parseMode (HTML & < > "; MarkdownV2 full set). The keyboard path adds no new substitution mechanism.

Button labels are NOT passed through the renderer at all (verbatim, by design — they are the keyword link), so there is no variable-substitution surface on labels; their only transform is the length clamp in preview / verbatim store + Jackson-escape at send.

confirmed_invariants.title: SSRF (A10) and copyOf snapshot integrity — no URLs in reply-keyboard buttons; keyboardRows defensively deep-copied
confirmed_invariants.owasp: A10:2021 Server-Side Request Forgery / A08:2021 Data Integrity
evidence: A10 (SSRF) is N/A for this feature: a reply-keyboard KeyboardButton carries ONLY a text label (KeyboardButton.java — single text component); there is no url/web_app field, so no user-controlled URL enters any server-side request. Stated explicitly rather than skipped. (The MESSAGE-composer media-URL SSRF surface is unchanged and out of scope here.)

FunnelStep.copyOf (FunnelStep.java:116-154): keyboard scalars (keyboardText/keyboardParseMode immutable Strings, isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard boxed Booleans) reference-copied; keyboardRows defensively copied via new ArrayList<>(source.keyboardRows) (line 152, null stays null) — elements (KeyboardRow/KeyboardButton) are immutable records, so the snapshot is isolated from later edits/duplicate (user-spec Risk 1). No shared-mutable-state integrity gap.

keyboard hint (Decision 8) is computed client-side from useFunnelsStore summaries (FunnelStepForm.vue:677-687) over already-loaded FunnelSummaryResponse data — no new endpoint, no new data exposure; the hint is advisory and never gates submit.

notes: Minor parity observation (NOT a security issue): SET_KEYBOARD onSubmit emits TRIMMED button texts (FunnelStepForm.vue:967 b.text.trim()), whereas the backend toKeyboardRows stores button text VERBATIM and trims only inside the duplicate check (FunnelService.java:822,1321). The net effect is benign — the editor sends pre-trimmed labels, the backend accepts them, and the duplicate check is trim-based on both sides. No injection or bypass; flagged only as a normalization note for the code audit (Task 8).

The frontend keyboard validation mirror (caps/duplicates/text) is UX-only; the authoritative gate is validateSetKeyboard/validateClearKeyboard (422). A bypassed client check does not weaken the posture.

previewStep falls back to a stub subscriber when the owner bot is not linked (FunnelService.java:415-418); the stub carries sample identity values and is never persisted/serialized as identity — only the rendered text reaches the client, consistent with the no-identity-leak contract of PreviewStepResponse.
